meta.database_name: NL Injury Tracker — Community MLB Injury Database
meta.description: Community-maintained MLB injury database tracking National League stars. Data sourced from official MLB, team reporters, and verified beat reporters.

players.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

types: Left hamstring strain (2nd occurrence this season)
current_injury.mechanism: Hamstring: strained running to first base. Fibula: non-displaced fracture in Spring Training.
current_injury.details: Grade 1 left hamstring strain placed on 10-day IL June 10. Hit grand slam in 3rd FCL rehab game (423 ft, 112.8 mph exit velocity). Went 0-for-3 with walk and 5 RBIs. Only serving as designated hitter — NOT cleared for outfield or live baserunning. Left fibula non-displaced fracture suffered Mar 3, 2026 in Spring Training. Rehab started April 2026. Slated to play for Triple-A Gwinnett on July 18-19 per MLB.com. Manager Walt Weiss: 'He's probably as strong as he's ever been... When we turn him loose, we want him to be ready to go.'

rehab_timeline.rehab_gate_warning: Must clear cutting drills before MiLB rehab. Any setback at this stage could push return to August or later.

players.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023 torn ACL. Rehab Gate watch is critical: BP → live pitching → straight-line running → cutting → MiLB rehab → MLB activation. Braves beat reporters Mark Bowman, @MarkBowmanBSB should be monitored for Rehab Gate updates. Ha-Seong Kim also in FCL rehab (finger inflammation). Teammate Andrew McCutchen also in FCL. Home Run Derby availability remains uncertain. Manager Weiss confirmed Acuña to play for Gwinnett July 18-19, rehab stint length TBD.

latest_update.event: FCL rehab ongoing. Grand slam in 3rd rehab game (423 ft, 112.8 mph). 0-f-3, 1 walk, 5 RBIs as DH. Cutting drills NOT cleared. Slated for Gwinnett rehab July 18-19.

players.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.mechanism: Back stiffness not from specific traumatic incident. Wrist soreness resolved with treatment. Residual fatigue from severe viral illness (late July 2025) causing ~25 lbs weight loss (175→150 lbs). Also experienced death of stepfather requiring personal leave.
current_injury.details: Out 3+ games as of July 13 for back stiffness. NOT expected on IL for back or wrist. Conservative day-to-day management. Resumed full workouts at Dodger Stadium. Manager Roberts: 'turned a corner' on viral recovery. New medication prescribed for stomach issues. On 7-game hitting streak with .355 avg over last 15 games. The most tumultuous stretch in recent memory for a star player.
current_injury.weight_loss: ~25 lbs during late July 2025 viral illness
current_injury.additional_context: Death of stepfather caused extended personal leave; recovered and returned for home opener late March 2025

rehab_timeline.expected_return: Within days (NOT IL expected for either current issue)
rehab_timeline.viral_recovery: New medication helping; full workout completed; weight stabilizing at ~150 lbs; 'turned a corner' per Roberts

injury_history.return_status: On IL (10-day); activated after 2 OKC rehab games
Returned late July; weight stabilizing at 150 lbs

players.notes: Most tumultuous recent stretch in memory: wrist fracture (x2), oblique strain (x2), severe viral illness, personal loss, back stiffness. All major injuries resolved. No IL expected for back or wrist. Conservative day-to-day management. 7-game hitting streak (.355 avg) shows he's at full strength. Lineup impact: after return, moved to 3B/DH with Freeman sliding to 2nd spot behind Ohtani. Amped up expectations for 2026 season after illness recovery.

latest_update.event: Back stiffness day-to-day; out 3+ games. 7-game hit streak (.355 avg over last 15). Playing SS/3B/OF. Manager Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better. Right now we're in a good spot — we're just managing day-to-day.' Weight stabilizing at 150 lbs. No IL expected for current issues.

players.name: Freddie Freeman
players.current_status: Active & Healthy; chronic ankle managed with load management

types: Chronic left ankle (managed via load management)
current_injury.mechanism: Neck stinger: from neck into right shoulder vs. Reds. Chronic ankle: from prior sprains requiring ongoing monitoring. March 2025 rib/scar tissue also re-aggravated during BP for Tokyo opener.
current_injury.details: No acute injury currently preventing play. Neck stinger fully resolved. Chronic left ankle from June 2025 sprain managed with load management and treatment. Manager Roberts: 'I feel confident he can get through it and won't have any setbacks.' No expected games missed. 75% certainty of playing through rib discomfort during 2025. Walk-Off Grand Slam in 2024 WS despite injuries. 2025: 30 SB in first 300 ABs, 25.9% walk rate, leading MLB in softball grounds. Lineup: Freeman moved to 2nd spot behind Ohtani after Betts' return.
current_injury.chronic_ankle_management: Ongoing load management; occasional flare-ups monitored

pre_injury_stats.2024_stats: WS MVP: Walk-Off Grand Slam, .280/.355/.565, 9 HR, 36 RBI, 25 SB
pre_injury_stats.2025_prior: 25.9% walk rate, 30 SB in first 300 ABs, leading MLB in softball grounds
pre_injury_stats.consistency: One of the most durable NL players historically

rehab_timeline.expected_return: N/A — Currently active and playing regularly
rehab_timeline.ankle_management: Ongoing with load management; occasional flare-ups monitored but no IL expected

injury_history.type: Left rib/scar tissue (Tokyo Dome opening day BP)

injury_history.return_status: Returned; played through 2024 postseason, WS MVP

players.notes: Chronic ankle issues (right debridement Dec 2024, left sprain Jun 2025) require ongoing monitoring. Walk-Off Grand Slam in 2024 WS legend despite injuries. Freeman is the most durable of the three tracked players. Moved to 2nd lineup spot in 2025 after Betts returned from illness. Dave Roberts confirmed no IL expected for current issues. 2026 projection: continuing as 1B anchor with load management for ankle.

latest_update.event: Out vs Reds Wednesday with neck stinger (neck into right shoulder). Returned to lineup Friday with no lingering effects. No IL expected. Chronic ankle managed. Roberts: 'nothing compromising... I feel confident he can get through it and won't have any setbacks.'

roster_impact.braves: Acuña's absence creates massive DH-only lineup hole. Bench needs +1B/H threat. Ha-Seong Kim also out (finger). Sean Murphy out (fractured finger). Robert Suarez and Spencer Strider on IL too.
roster_impact.dodgers: Betts returned and playing SS/3B/OF. Freeman sliding to 2nd spot behind Ohtani. Max Muncy and Tommy Edman also recovering from oblique/ankle injuries.
roster_impact.championship_impact: Dodgers likely still favorites with core healthy. Braves missing Acuña long-term diminishes 2026 NL East chances.

instructions: 1. Fork the repository and create a new branch for your changes
2. Update or add injury data in nl-injury-updates.json (machine-readable) or LATEST-INFO.md (human-readable)
3. Submit a pull request with a clear description of what was changed and why
4. If reporting a new injury, include the date, details, rehab timeline, return status, and source where available
5. Always cross-reference with official sources: MLB.com, team press releases, and recognized beat reporters
6. Ensure JSON validity before pushing edits to nl-injury-updates.json
data_format_guidelines: status_color: green=Active, yellow=Day-to-Day/Rehabbing, red=Out on IL
Always include source URLs for verifiable information
Update last_updated field when making changes
Add new entries to injury_history array (most recent first)
